clauses.text: 1. Purpose and Scope

source_location.excerpt: 1. Purpose and Scope

clauses.text: This Annexure (“Annexure A”) forms an integral part of the Master Services Agreement (“MSA”) executed between PrimeVolta Hardware Solutions (“Vendor”) and FinSecure Services (“Client”) dated [Insert Date]. The purpose of this Annexure is to define, formalize, and document the industry-specific regulatory and compliance obligations applicable to the provision of electronic hardware solutions by the Vendor to the Client. The scope of this Annexure encompasses compliance with all applicable Indian laws, regulatory guidelines issued by the Reserve Bank of India (RBI), Securities and Exchange Board of India (SEBI) where relevant, the Information Technology Act, 2000, and any other statutory or regulatory requirements governing the handling, processing, storage, and transmission of sensitive financial and customer data within the BFSI sector. This Annexure applies to all hardware supplied, installed, or maintained by the Vendor as part of services under the MSA and covers all personnel, subcontractors, and associated entities engaged in the delivery of services.

clauses.text: 2. Regulatory Compliance Obligations

source_location.excerpt: 2. Regulatory Compliance Obligations

clauses.text: The Vendor and Client mutually agree to comply with all applicable statutory, regulatory, and industry standards as outlined below:

source_location.excerpt: The Vendor and Client mutually agree to comply with all applicable statutory, regulatory, and industry standards as outlined below:

clauses.text:
a. RBI Guidelines Compliance:
The Vendor shall ensure that all hardware, firmware, and related components comply with RBI directions relating to outsourcing, IT infrastructure, cyber security, and risk management. This includes adherence to circulars concerning operational resilience, storage of sensitive customer data within Indian territory, and regular reporting of incidents that may impact system integrity.

source_location.excerpt:
a. RBI Guidelines Compliance:
The Vendor shall ensure that all hardware, firmware, and related components comply with RBI directions relating to outsourcing, IT infrastructure, cyber security, and risk management. This includes adherence to circulars concerning operational resilience, storage of sensitive customer data within Indian territory, and regular reporting of incidents that may impact system integrity.

clauses.text:
b. IT Act and Data Protection Compliance:
Both parties shall comply with the Information Technology Act, 2000, and its amendments, ensuring secure handling, storage, and transmission of electronic records. All personally identifiable information (PII) and financial information processed using the Vendor’s hardware shall be protected using industry-standard encryption and access controls. Any breach of confidentiality or data compromise must be reported to the Client and, if required, to the appropriate regulatory authority, within the timelines mandated by law.

source_location.excerpt:

clauses.text:
c. Security Standards and Frameworks:
The Vendor agrees to implement and maintain IT and cybersecurity controls aligned with ISO/IEC 27001, NIST Cybersecurity Framework, and RBI-recommended technology controls. The Client shall have the right to request periodic evidence of compliance, including but not limited to internal audit reports, vulnerability assessments, penetration testing reports, and any third-party certification reports.

clauses.text:
d. Audit and Reporting:
Both parties agree to participate in regular compliance audits. The Vendor shall provide full access to all relevant logs, configuration records, and reports relating to the supplied hardware. Audits may be internal or conducted by third-party auditors appointed by the Client. Any non-conformities identified shall be addressed promptly with corrective actions agreed mutually.

clauses.text: 3. Vendor Obligations

source_location.excerpt: 3. Vendor Obligations

source_location.excerpt: Ensure that all electronic hardware supplied is free from malware and meets security requirements mandated by RBI and other regulatory bodies.

clauses.text: Maintain a configuration management system to track all hardware assets supplied to the Client.

clauses.text: 5. Mutual Obligations and Risk Management

source_location.excerpt: 5. Mutual Obligations and Risk Management

clauses.text: Both parties shall establish a joint risk management framework for hardware-related operational, security, and regulatory risks.

clauses.text: 6. Confidentiality and Data Protection

source_location.excerpt: 6. Confidentiality and Data Protection

clauses.text: The parties acknowledge that hardware systems may store or process sensitive financial and personal information. Both parties agree to maintain confidentiality in accordance with contractual obligations and regulatory requirements. Any third-party engagement relating to hardware support must adhere to the same standards of confidentiality and compliance. Unauthorized disclosure, modification, or destruction of data shall constitute a material breach of this Annexure.

clauses.text: 7. Amendments and Updates

source_location.excerpt: 7. Amendments and Updates

clauses.text: This Annexure may be updated from time to time to reflect changes in applicable laws, RBI circulars, or industry best practices. Any such updates shall be documented in writing, mutually agreed upon, and shall form part of the MSA.

source_location.excerpt: 8. Governing Law and Jurisdiction

clauses.text: This Annexure shall be governed by and construed in accordance with the laws of India. Any disputes arising out of or in connection with this Annexure shall be subject to the exclusive jurisdiction of courts in [City, State].
